Generate Initial Events for the RRMS DES Model

gen_init_events.Rd

Generates the initial time-to-event draws for all model events at the start of each patient's simulation, for all treatment arms. Returns a WARDEN add_tte() object consumed by run_sim_new via the init_event_list argument in rrmsdesmodel.

Usage

gen_init_events(RRMS_events)

Arguments

RRMS_events

Character vector of model event names, passed from v_event_names set by rrmsdessetup. Defines which events receive an initial time-to-event draw.

Value

A WARDEN add_tte() object containing initial time-to-event draws for all events in RRMS_events across all arms in v_treatment_names, passed to run_sim_new via the init_event_list argument in rrmsdesmodel.

Details

Initial event times are drawn once per patient at simulation entry using add_tte. Events are generated across all arms in v_treatment_names. Each event uses parameters from the common global inputs (gen_common_all_inputs) and individual patient inputs (gen_unique_pt_inputs) available in the WARDEN simulation environment.

The following events are initialised:

initialise, annual_treatment, age

Set to 0. These are structural trigger events handled by the reaction event and updated annually. #' relapse

Drawn from an exponential distribution using baseline log-rate for HARRMS patients modified by the treatment-specific ARR rate ratio from the NMA.

edss_increase

Drawn from an exponential distribution using baseline log-rate for HARRMS patients modified by the treatment-specific CDP6 hazard ratio from the NMA,

edss_decrease

Drawn from an exponential distribution for patients.

progression

Drawn from an exponential distribution. Only applies to patients with edss_value > 4 and spms_flag = 0. Uses the MS Registry HARRMS-to-SPMS conversion rate.

death

Drawn from a piecewise exponential distribution using age-sex-specific all-cause mortality rates modified by MS-specific mortality multiplier the EDSS-severity.

serious_adverse_event

Drawn from an exponential distribution using the baseline SAE rate modified by the treatment-specific SAE hazard ratio from the NMA .

treatment_switch

Drawn from an exponential distribution using the baseline discontinuation hazard modified by the treatment-specific discontinuation hazard ratios.
